value.text: Review classes A-D implemented. Parsed-model commands keep canonical flags and equals-form pm-arg pairs, ignore embedding argv, retain the native tracker path once, provide PowerShell plus lossless argv, and require the original stdin pipe without advertising a standalone command. Upgrade attribution requires an exact previous-renderer match AND different declared revisions; unproved/current-version reorders explain timestamp or manual edits. Blank-separated details remain entry units. Added distinct 2026.11.10 contract and empty-pending upgrade facets and a rendering-change tag/catalog invariant. Proof baseline chooses a pinned merge base or working-tree source and owns its diagnostic mutation, avoiding no-op fallback. Initial gates: 16/16 regression tests, classifier-only 100 percent lines/branches/functions, 3/3 baseline selection controls; 15 independent behavioral mutants caused 17 assertion failures followed by 16/16 restored controls. Both requested B regressions fail on their function-only mutations. Full source-clone/archive proof and all importing test files are next; prior completed delivery hygiene is preserved.
